title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Crashes to $67,500, Lowest Since August, as Dollar Holds 19-Month High
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Briefly Crashes to $67,500, Lowest Since August, as Dollar Holds 19-Month High Bitcoin price briefly crashed to about $67,555 around midnight Eastern, its lowest level since August, then recovered near $69,800 on Friday after October producer prices rose less than expected. This post Bitcoin Price Briefly Crashes to $67,500, Lowest Since August, as Dollar Holds 19-Month High first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
